A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] '''[[Kumumgah/Legends|Kumumgah]]''' lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] rule. When the planet was [[Conquest of Tatooine|conquered]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], they burned his city and imprisoned the survivors. Brought out onto a cliff on the outskirts of the ruined city with a young boy named [[Lonai]] and the boy's father, the three knelt shackled before [[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]] as the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] determined who among them was Forceful. Determining him to be capable of touching [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Rakatan guards killed Lonai and the boy's father before escorting the Forceful Kumumgah to a ship which would take him offworld for [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]].
